The largest bone in the human body is the femur.

Regarding the effectiveness of the described physical therapy technique, myofascial release therapy appears to be an effective intervention for specific conditions such as myofascial pain syndrome. By applying gentle, sustained pressure to the fascial connective tissues, the technique aims to alleviate restrictions in motion and reduce pain. This approach is particularly useful for treating sensitive points in the muscles, which can help relieve discomfort and improve the patient's range of motion.
